scene.visual_brief: انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای؛ تصمیم‌های طراحی آبیاری | انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای | آشنایی با انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره‌ای، نکات طراحی، فاصله خروجی‌ها و انتخاب مناسب بر اساس شرایط مزرعه. راهنمای کاربردی وبلاگ آموزشی AFP. | مقدمه انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای نقش کلیدی در برنامه‌ریزی آبیاری و نیازسنجی مزرعه دارند. پیش از هر تصمیم طراحی، شناخت عملکرد فشار، فاصله خروجی‌ها و ظرفیت دبی هر مدل ضروری است، چرا که خطا در این مرحله مستقیماً بر یکنواختی توزیع آب و راندمان آبیاری تأثیر می‌گذارد. در این مقاله آموزشی انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای بررسی شده و نکات فنی لازم برای انتخاب دقیق بر اساس مشخصات برگه سازنده ارائه می‌شود. انواع اصلی نوار تیپ

cases.prompt: One continuous photorealistic agricultural photograph, medium three-quarter technical view, soft natural daylight. Setting: a non-geolocated agricultural crop bed with soil; no invented location or climate. Main subject: neutral small seedlings, continuous thin flattened installed drip-tape laterals and localized root-zone wetting. A few neutral small seedlings beside the irrigation bed; no invented named crop. Tight equipment-and-soil framing with no skyline. Place the complete commercial package in the LOWER-LEFT quarter on a dedicated dry-soil island. Keep ALL installed irrigation lines in the RIGHT half, at least one carton diameter away from the package footprint. No line behind the carton, no collinear line disappearing under its front rim and reappearing behind it. No loose coil, no spare roll, no tape emerging from the carton; all installed tape remains straight along the planted rows. Show a broad uninterrupted dry-soil gap all around the base. The off-axis package is a standalone commercial package on soil, visibly separated from all pipes and fittings, never on the irrigation route: exactly one upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton, white printed sleeve and blue lower band, central top hole. Match the supplied reference sidewall-height-to-diameter proportions; no vertical compression or exaggerated width. Show its full sidewall with a modest top ellipse. It occupies about 20 percent of frame width. A visible strip of bare soil separates the entire carton base from every pipe; never balance or rest the carton on plumbing. No white ribbon, strap or printed strip emerges from the carton; installed drip tape is a separate thin black flattened lateral. Keep the required technical fitting unobstructed in the foreground. No pipe passes through its central hole; the carton is never a coupling, sleeve, filter, valve or installed hardware. Connect only the separate thin flattened drip tape, never its package, to the header. The reference is an identity guide, not a flat layer to paste. Reconstruct it in the same perspective and light, with ground contact and realistic shadows. Keep each product fully inside the frame with clear margins; preserve authentic shape, material and package print. Equipment and plants are the story, products are secondary. Empty scene, no people. Single photograph, no inset, pasted panel, extra product or added writing. primary_review.reasons: The image features the correct recognizable AFP drip tape roll placed in an appropriate agricultural scene with irrigation lines. However, the branding text on the product packaging is illegible and appears to be incorrectly rendered or hallucinated, which constitutes a core defect. Additionally, the black lines visible on the ground are thick supply pipes rather than flattened drip tape laterals, creating a minor discrepancy with the technical evidence.

independent_physical_review.reason: A flat white strip/ribbon physically emerges from the right side of the required package and lies on the soil, which is a distinct protruding strip defect. The soil gap is not considered clear because of this physical attachment/protrusion. Irrigation lines pass in the foreground and background but do not touch or cross the package footprint. No distinct additional loose coils are present.

However, the expected commercial product count is strictly 1, but two distinct carton rolls are visible in the foreground. This product count mismatch prevents a score of 90 or higher.
